scientific_integrity: The complete all-parameter proof is mathematical and separate from finite checks. Prior generic tree shellability, full-whiskering classifications, and the path boundary case are acknowledged. Residual novelty risk: potentially unindexed equivalent literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem addresses only the three-path-free (r=2) complex of a four-spine double broom with two nonempty endpoint leaf classes. It makes no assertion for longer spines, other thresholds or equivariant representations. Finite mod-two checks corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter integral homotopy type. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Quadratic three-sphere wedges in three-path-free complexes of double brooms
